name: How do I choose the right style of interior window trim for my home?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right style of interior window trim for my home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right style of interior window trim depends on your home's architectural style and your personal taste. Consider whether your home has a traditional, modern, farmhouse, or craftsman aesthetic. Simpler profiles, like a shaker or colonial style, suit contemporary and traditional homes, respectively. More ornate casings may complement older or more decorative interiors. We recommend gathering inspiration photos and considering how the trim will integrate with existing baseboards and crown molding for a cohesive look. This preparation helps ensure the new trim enhances your home's overall design.
acceptedAnswer.description: Select a window trim style that complements your home's architectural style and existing moldings. Consider options from simple to ornate.
